capabilities: Show word, character, and reading-time counts beside headings, below the note title, and in the status bar
Set whole-note or per-section writing targets stored as portable Target lines
Track target progress with count, percentage, or remaining labels and colour-coded progress bars
Count readable prose while excluding frontmatter, code, embeds, comments, and target lines
Toggle badges, status bar stats, or all counting through palette commands
extras: Version 1.1.0 and newer requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer. Counts use fast Markdown cleanup rather than Obsidian's full renderer, so content from other plugins, transclusions, and complex math may differ slightly from what is displayed.
intentEvidence: Live word counts, character counts, reading time, and writing-target progress for every section of an Obsidian note.
problem: Obsidian's word count covers the whole note only, so writers cannot see the length or reading time of individual sections or track progress toward section-level targets.
summary: Section statistics plugin that shows live word, character, and reading-time counts beside headings and in the status bar, with per-section writing targets.
